scope: Issue 60 kanji only; support words as necessary; not an official JLPT syllabus.

kanjidic2.transformation: Complete parsed character records for all members plus 妖 are reserialized in n1-sources/kanjidic2-selected.xml. The source index selects ja_on/ja_kun in source order; nanori and old JLPT labels are not transported into teaching metadata. Raw records remain intact.

jmdict.limits: Actual frozen dictionary bytes only; applicable complete lexical families, spelling/reading/sense restrictions and author inspection still pending.

unicode.transformation: Classical radical n uses the compatibility decomposition at U+2F00+n-1.

kanjivg.limits: Canonical SVG inventory and blob identities only; SVG downloads, conversion and stroke-count reconciliation still pending.
